items.title: Bluesky blocks links to leaked DHS employee data as government seeks takedowns
items.summary: The social networking site is facing criticism for blocking access to the site, which identifies thousands of ICE agents and other employees working for Homeland Security.
items.creator: Zack Whittaker

items.title: DoorDash to acquire Instacart for $17B
items.summary: The acquisition would bring two major players in on-demand delivery under one roof, combining DoorDash’s dominance in restaurant takeout with Instacart’s reach in grocery delivery.
items.creator: Aisha Malik
